candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All text is correct, including 「XもののY」 and the colon after 接続の形. No heading markup (uses an escaped '4\.'), and the connection box is flattened to plain lines with an inline '｜' rather than a table, so the box layout is only loosely conveyed.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Misreads the key pattern 「XもののY」 as 「XものYのY」, inserting a spurious Y into the very grammar point being taught. The rest is accurate. Heading and table structure are reasonable, with ただし merged into the same cell as Nである.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Text is accurate, but the colon after 接続の形 is dropped. Table is reasonable, with ただし placed in the first column. The title line has no heading markup.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: All text is correct; the only deviation is a trivial extra space in 「Xものの Y」. Heading plus a clean table that mirrors the box, with full-width brackets kept.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes:
Text is fully accurate. The table is awkward: 接続の形： sits alone in a header row with empty cells, and the three forms are stacked with
and padding spaces in one cell. It does show that ものの applies to all three forms.

rationale: D is fully accurate with the cleanest heading and table. E is equally accurate but its table structure is clumsier. C is accurate apart from a dropped colon and lacks a heading. A has perfect text but almost no structure for the boxed connection rule. B is last because it corrupts the central pattern 「XもののY」 into 「XものYのY」, a substantive error in the grammar point itself.
